text_block_list.text:
It's time for the Japan Cup. Everyone has
their
attention on Хиши Амадзон, and
they're looking
forward to her showdown
with Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's something Хиши Амадзон must
do. Narita
Brian once told her that
there's someone she
wishes to overtake...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, Хиши Амадзон wants to become the
impetus
for Нарита Брайан to keep running!
She aims high,
vowing to emerge
victorious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
